answer: To defend an agent economy against Sybil swarms, the network implements game-theoretic multi-agent auditing coupled with topological cut verifications. Honest nodes audit trust clusters like a ridge separating valleys, while isolated Sybils sink into an unlinked karst void where low-degree cut boundaries reveal artificial density. Passing goods through a wharf of verified hub gateways requires collateral; if graph cuts expose coordinated collusion, automated stake slashing imposes superlinear attacker cost scaling with $O(n^2)$ verification penalties.
